README.Item: Project Sangam — Simulated GCPL Dataset v4
README.Guidance: Canonical prototype alignment edition — prepared to match the latest deck-alignment feedback
Linked illustrative data for the eight-screen Lovable prototype. GCPL is fictional; account/entity/transaction data are simulated.

The revised Master Website Specification v4 and this workbook govern the prototype. Latest prototype-alignment values supersede earlier prototype drafts. Do not upload older conflicting solution drafts as extra Lovable instructions.
Cash ₹12,000,000,000; debt ₹15,000,000,000; eligible same-currency surplus ₹6,000,000,000; headline overlap ₹9,300,000,000 → ₹3,300,000,000 by Month 7.
Annual benefit ₹139,073,200; running cost ₹46,169,250; net benefit ₹92,903,950; one-time cost ₹85,025,100; payback Week 71 (approximately Month 17).
Baseline 25 banks / 102 accounts; target 7 banks / 42 accounts by Week 39; 60 accounts proposed for offline rationalisation/closure subject to approvals. No closure action exists in the UI.
Target Accounts has 42 unique records: 25 operating, 6 second-currency, 3 active pool headers, 3 local-rule accounts and 5 standby accounts.

HSBC: Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, UK. Citi: USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, UAE, Bangladesh. Standard Bank: South Africa only. Scotiabank: Ireland only. Indian bank is existing partner for parent main accounts, named in Week 4. Two relationship lenders pending loan register review (Day 90).

Active EUR header: HSBC Netherlands; active USD header: Citi USA and only the three US companies; active INR header: parent at selected Indian bank. EUR standby at Citi Netherlands; USD standby at HSBC USA; Indian parent standby at HSBC India. Standby accounts are not active pool headers.

USD group only includes the three US companies. Canada is CAD and Mexico is MXN, both under 'Repay at home' and outside the USD pool. Cash/debt: USD ₹1,200,000,000/₹1,500,000,000; CAD ₹400,000,000/₹500,000,000; MXN ₹400,000,000/₹500,000,000.

Native amounts and INR-equivalent fields are separate. Rates are static illustrative assumptions. Use ₹96.85/USD for rupee-equivalent values shown beside deck headline figures; clearly label every rate illustrative.
40% of cash is only an initial modelling stand-in. The operating rule is the largest weekly net outflow in the 13-week forecast plus 20%, reset quarterly and four weeks before seasonal peaks.

Exactly seven, in the specified order. Bank/account counts are milestone only, not a KPI. KPI 4 is count-based. FX TCA baseline is assumed 15 bps measured during Weeks 2–8; target 10 bps by Month 6. Straight-through rate target 85% by Month 12.
Every payment requires a maker, independent checker and sanctions screening. Above the configured threshold, a front-office approver also signs; threshold is illustrative.
Brazil BRL, Bangladesh BDT and South Africa ZAR remain locally visible and are excluded from the deployable overlap headline; no daily overseas sweeps.

No live data feeds, real bank connectivity, real approvals, real payment/FX execution, investment placement or account closure. Use 'Illustrative demo data' or 'Simulated'; never use a 'Live data' badge.
Screen 7 is assessment-only. No close-account button or closure workflow. Rationalisation recommendations are offline decision support.
Screen 8 policy library and version history are read-only; company policy changes are entered in the backend later.
Show seven KPIs exactly. Bank/account counts 7/42 are milestones by Week 39. Overlap headline is ₹9,300,000,000 → ₹3,300,000,000 by Month 7.
Use demo date 17 October 2026 and programme-relative Week/Month milestones. Never show 2025 demo dates or confuse demo transaction timestamps with programme roadmap dates.
